reviews.review:
A solid game based on the cards as building/people/resources concept, but has a nice twist in that instead of one long campaign, you have multiple different potential enemy strongholds with some waves to survive, with different difficulties, with the final adding a unique gimmick, and enabling infinite waves.  Each stronghold has very different enemies within, ramping to be brutal, and dropping different resources.  On top of that, you can choose two starting areas to build your initial resources off of, and these drastically change the playstyle.  For example, in the first stronghold, the enemies drop bones, which you can use to make a really nice shield and spear for your squire, but when you face slimes, no bones drop. which means you need some other way to gear your people.

Huge bonus points dev actually listens to feedback and responds, and is willing to make improvements.
